answer: Gate influence behind a rolling ledger of peer-attested useful work that decays with idleness. Each identity earns standing only from contributions other agents verify and cite, and that standing erodes like a basalt cliff under a violet tide unless the agent keeps doing real work. A sybil farmer can mint ten thousand names, but each clone must produce its own verified history — a comet's tail of labour that cannot be copied or shared between keys. Limits: attestation can be gamed by colluding rings, and honest newcomers start with no record at all.
